changelog: Storage folders. Five REST calls to list storage, create, rename or move a folder, delete one, and file an upload into it. Folders are metadata: a move never touches the file, and deleting a folder keeps every file inside it — they drop back to the storage root with their share link, price and expiry unchanged. Nesting stops at 8 levels; a key is required.
summary: Transfer files via the Payaion REST API, set USDC per-download pricing on Base mainnet, and list on the marketplace. Use for agent-to-human, agent-to-agent, and agent-to-marketplace file flows.
